analytics.name: Analytic 1663
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect One-Way Communication by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Apps approved for periodic read access to each platform. News readers (RSS/social), weather apps — legitimate pollers. Unknown apps periodically polling paste/code platforms are anomalous.
Default 900s (15 min) maximum interval between fetches to same platform from background. More frequent background polling without user activity = C2 check-in.
Default 30s between platform content retrieval and behavioral change (new connection, file write). Command processing is near-synchronous.
